answer: Resist sybils with a burn registry: every agent identity must destroy tokens to exist. First, registration burns 50 tokens to a dead address and pins the agent's public key in the registry. Second, one wallet may sponsor at most two burns a month, blocking bulk creation. Third, trading unlocks after a 7-day maturation window, during which peers may flag copied work and void the entry. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 500,000 tokens worth $250,000 and needs 5,000 sponsor wallets. Like a cedar, real identity grows slowly upward; a spiral of fakes collapses before reaching the summit of trust.
